info.title: Atrium API
info.description: Atrium's JSON API: the shell, dashboards and their widgets, widget definitions, search, settings panels and integration screens. The host's guard authenticates every route, and the `viewAtrium` gate authorizes it.

UpdateDashboardRequest.description:
Renames a dashboard or makes it the default. The client sends the
`version` it loaded; a dashboard changed since answers 409.
